title: McMoneagle tasked to remote view Mars a million years ago

tellings.quote: psychic spy program and he was given this is now public and declassified he was given coordinates to remote view on Mars a million years in the past. Yes.

plain: In the 1980s, a remote viewer named Joe McMoneagle, someone trained to describe faraway places using only the mind, was given coordinates on Mars and told to view it as it was a million years in the past. Michels tells this himself, saying it comes from the US Army's psychic spy program and is "now public and declassified." He raises it in a talk about whether Mars once had life, because it would mean the government took that question seriously enough to send a psychic to look.
